name: Remote Receiver → On Nexus
description: An automation to perform when a Nexus RF code has been decoded. A variable `x` of type <APIStruct text="remote_base::NexusData" path="remote_base::NexusData" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. It carries `channel` (1 to 4), `address`, `temperature` in °C, `humidity` in %, `battery_level` (`true` while the battery is fine) and `force_update` (`true` for a transmission started by the sensor's button). Each sensor repeats its code several times per transmission.
